items.q: How much does a private chef cost in Marrakech?
items.a: From €85 per person, all-inclusive. Minimum 2 guests. A couple pays €170, a family of four €340, a group of eight €680.
items.linkText: Full pricing breakdown by group size.

items.a: Everything: menu planning, the chef's morning visit to the souk, all ingredients and cookware, cooking, plating and table service, mint-tea ceremony, and full kitchen cleanup.
Wine and drinks, premium add-ons (live cooking stations), chef tip (10% local norm, not required), and luxury produce beyond the standard budget — quoted separately.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: 72 hours is ideal. Peak season (October–April) or groups over 10: 1–2 weeks. Last-minute (under 48 hours) regularly possible.
50% deposit on confirmation, balance on the night. Stripe, wire (EUR/USD), Apple Pay, Visa/Mastercard, or MAD cash.
> 7 days: 50% deposit refunded. 2–7 days: credited to future booking. < 48 hours: non-refundable. Force majeure case by case.
Traditional Moroccan: tagines, pastilla, royal couscous, the seven salads, mechoui lamb, traditional desserts, mint tea. Mediterranean and French influences possible on request.
Halal by default — all meat from certified halal butchers in the medina souk. Kosher, vegetarian, and vegan menus run in parallel on request.
Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, kosher, allergies, low-carb, dairy-free — no extra charge. Tell us at booking. Menu is shared in writing for you to approve.

items.q: Can I request a specific menu?
items.a: Yes. We work from what's at the souk that morning, not a fixed list. Want a specific tagine, a non-Moroccan course, a kid-friendly section, a fully bespoke tasting menu — flag it in the brief and we'll cost it.
Yes — a working oven, gas hob (4 burners ideal), sink with hot water, and a fridge with at least one shelf empty. We bring all cookware.

items.q: Can the chef cook at a medina riad?
items.a: Yes. Riad kitchens are smaller but the souk is 50 metres away. Service moves to the courtyard or rooftop. Maximum 12–14 guests realistically.

items.q: Can the chef cook in the desert?
items.a: Yes — Agafay desert camps are a regular venue. We bring everything; cooking is over charcoal or wood fire. Flat €60 per person transport add-on for desert dinners.

items.q: How many guests can the chef serve?
items.a: From 2 to 30+. Minimum 2. €85 per person up to 19 guests; for 20+ we move to the event tier (custom quote, full service brigade). For 50–200+ events, see the wedding page.
Yes. Wedding bookings start at €1,200 for 20 guests, scaling to 200+. Full brigade, table styling, mint-tea ceremony, cleanup included.

items.q: Can you cater a corporate dinner or offsite?
items.a: Yes. From €650 for 10 guests, full service. Multilingual team (EN/FR/AR default). EUR or USD invoicing, VAT-compliant. NDAs available.
Yes — as an add-on to the chef dinner, €200 for up to 6 guests, at your villa or riad.
